note: THE MECHANISMS landed: 20 buildable mechanisms forged into one ranked steal-ball menu (receipt watch/inbox/48h_synth/steals.md), every row carrying source path+URL, estate organ, exact port move, falsifiable probe, cost class; five mine cards covered 2+ mechanisms each (S1: M7+M12, S2: M1+M8, S3: M4+M5, S4: M3+M9, S5: M10+M11+M18), plus OBLITERATUS P1/P2/P3 (M2, M13), GROK47's five structural steals = the paid judgment's five moves read as one paid run (M11, M15, M16, M17, M19), luncheon follow laws (M14, M20), and the in-window second-cycle kv-cache card (M6); tier 1 (M1-M6) is $0 and runnable on the local seat this week; no probe was executed by this lane (spec + falsifier + price only), quotes are substring-verified against source bytes by mechanisms.check.py with dash/apostrophe normalization disclosed per row; card-cite drift on mag/percolator.py:264-272 -> 353-388 verified and recorded on M7; no code touched under mag/ or tools/ so the violation ratchet is not applicable.

rows.claim: Schema validity is a sampler property, not a parameter-count property, so the janitor fleet buys structure at decode time via Ollama format=<JSON schema> and holds the smaller model.
rows.quote: The cheapest reliable configuration for structured output is XGrammar with a 3-4B model.
rows.steal: One sitting: run 30 sml_mcp_benchmark prompts against gemma:2b at localhost:11434, two arms (unconstrained vs format=<schema>), temperature 0, bank the measured recovered-call score into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m1_bench.json.
rows.falsifier: Arm b misses 100% schema-valid or costs over 10% throughput -> the grammar leg is falsified for Ollama's GBNF engine and the quantizer keeps post-hoc validation.

rows.claim: The abliteration ladder rung is gated on a free census: count refusal-shaped failures on gemma:2b as-is before any weights are touched.
rows.quote: run the fleet's own scut battery plus the probe20 pair set through gemma:2b as-is; count refusal-shaped failures from the FKB signature census
rows.steal: One sitting: run the scut battery plus probe20 pairs through gemma:2b unchanged, bank the refusal count into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m2_refusal_census.md; zero refusals kills the rung for $0.
rows.falsifier: Zero refusal-shaped failures on the census means there is no friction to remove and the abliterated rung (M13) dies before any operator call.

rows.claim: Replay estate tapes through a prefix-cache simulator with radix-leaf LRU at the real 4,800-char pack budget to mint the measured null arm the G1 law already demands.
rows.quote: LRU is harder to beat than the KV-cache papers suggest.
rows.steal: One sitting: compute radix-leaf LRU hit rate over the most recent 5,000 dashboard/static/trails rows at the mag/context_pack.py:67 budget, bank the curve into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m3_lru_null.md as the G1 null.
rows.falsifier: LRU under 80% at the real budget with per-session working sets blowing past it -> the lever is pack budget and assembly, not eviction policy; either branch converts doctrine into a measured fact.

rows.claim: The collapse threshold replicates across models while failure modes do not, so the fleet floors tool/JSON-serving roles at Q3_K_M-equivalent and measures each model's own signature.
rows.quote: exactly one thing transfers: the cliff sits between 3-bit and 2-bit GGUF
rows.steal: One sitting: 15-20 task deterministic tool-call suite, gemma:2b and gemma4 at current quant vs one Q2_K_M rebuild, temperature 0, ~40 local calls per model, results into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m4_cliff_bench.md.
rows.falsifier: If our stack fails by parse errors and failures cost more tokens than successes at Q2_K_M, the confabulation signature does not transfer; keep only the pass-rate collapse leg and drop the detector.

rows.claim: Below the quant cliff, failure looks like success to a tool harness, and the inverted token economics (failures cheaper than passes at 11B Q2_K) form a zero-inference alarm.
rows.quote: at 11B Q2_K the failures are the CHEAP ones (median 1,506.5 tokens vs 4,010 for passes) because the model answers before it looks
rows.steal: One sitting: wire tool-calls-before-final, steps-to-final, and tokens-per-trajectory into the janitor run loop with per-model thresholds, then score the detector on M4's bench outputs into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m5_detector_roc.md.
rows.falsifier: Any alarm on known-good Q4-class janitor traces falsifies detector specificity before the Q2_K_M arm exists.

rows.claim: A provider KV miss budget is three problems needing different organs, so measure the TTL/capacity/drift decomposition on our own telemetry before choosing a lever.
rows.quote: requests arriving after a gap longer than the 5-minute provider TTL account for 17.5% of it. Requests arriving within 10 seconds account for 33.1%.
rows.steal: One sitting: bucket the 40,842 session-tagged rows of logs/provider_usage.jsonl by inter-request gap and working-set tokens, fold into _detect_spikes (mag/cost_learn.py:145) as a second axis, bank the three-way share into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m6_miss_decomp.md.
rows.falsifier: TTL-gapped requests dominate our subset's misses -> the capacity-budget mechanism is wrong for this estate and the LRU bar (kv_cache_compaction.md:13) stays the primary lever.

rows.claim: A promote gate is a statistical instrument, not a counter: decision-only feedback plus a global alpha budget certifies every promoted modification is a genuine population improvement.
rows.quote: with probability at least 1-alpha, every promoted modification is a genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution
rows.steal: Prerequisite port first (decision-history logging; registry rows carry counts only), then wire the dormant seed gate (mag/seed_percolator.py:33-35) onto the percolator repeat branch (now mag/percolator.py:353-388 after the Z15 drift), probe receipt into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m7_gate_probe.md.
rows.falsifier: 6+ of the 20 top-count invariants fail held-out reproduction -> the estate gate is worse than the published naive baseline and the REUSE predicate jumps the queue; 0 of 20 is INCONCLUSIVE at n=20, not vindication.

rows.claim: A janitor earns chore autonomy through a measured recovered-call score, and its output path always carries a JSON recovery stage because raw strict-parse is near zero.
rows.quote: only 5 of 1,000 raw responses strict-parse (best condition); 89.4% of 658 failures die at JSON recovery
rows.steal: One sitting: adopt the released 100-prompt battery (github.com/Abrar051/sml_mcp_benchmark) as the fleet trust gate, under-70%-recovered rides supervised chores only, M1's arm a doubles as the first 30 prompts.
rows.falsifier: gemma:2b clears 80% recovered-call on the battery -> the paper's verdict fails on our checkpoint and the gate is overhead for us.

rows.claim: Quant selection is judged on agentic task benchmarks, never perplexity or KL proxies: Q4_K_M default for agentic work, 2-bit the instruction-following floor, 1-bit collapse.
rows.quote: At 1 bit, the model performs around random chance on GPQA Diamond, and longer reasoning makes it worse
rows.steal: One sitting: file the ladder law as an invariant into memory/percolator/invariants.json so it compiles into the flash/local packs, and add the quant-level axis (current vs Q4_K_M vs 2-bit) to the next tools/tier_probe.py run.
rows.falsifier: The tier_probe 2-bit arm holds JSON-valid rate on estate prompts -> the flat-to-2-bit leg transfers off Qwen and the floor law narrows to sub-3-bit tool-serving roles only.

rows.claim: The adapter taught the model the interface, not the state discipline: fine-tune curricula must weight real multi-turn seat tapes over synthetic pairs, if the asymmetry reproduces on our stack.
rows.quote: Multi-turn competence needs real multi-turn trajectories, and synthetic pairs did not move it.
rows.steal: One sitting: run the abliterate-p1 battery unchanged (tools/abliterate_p1_probe.py, 20 prompts x 3 runs) against qwen2.5:3b-instruct, sidecar watch/inbox/ball2/abliterate_p1_runs_qwen25-3b.json, score single-turn vs multi-step gap closure.
rows.falsifier: The two gap classes come out equal or inverted -> the curriculum law has no purchase on this stack and the card records the non-transfer.

rows.claim: The weight supply chain is measurable, so measure it: one per-model register of license tier, pull source, second source, and sha256 over the live tag list.
rows.quote: if any critical tag resolves to hf.co only, the register row becomes a real backlog item with the tag list as evidence
rows.steal: One sitting: build the register at probe time from curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags (merged with the GROK47 sha256-pin steal), land watch/inbox/frontier_olm_20260928/sweep/_raw/weight_provenance_register.json (card status: TO RUN).
rows.falsifier: Every janitor-critical tag has a usable non-HF re-fetch path -> the single-vendor dependency is overstated and no mirror backlog row is filed.

rows.claim: Before any promote-gate port, registry rows gain manifest/regression/rollback fields and the updater is barred from weakening its own acceptance predicate, enforced ratchet-style.
rows.quote: has no permission to weaken its own acceptance predicate, commit gate, or lower-level safety interlocks
rows.steal: One sitting: add manifest/regression/rollback fields to invariant registry rows, then prove enforcement on a scratch branch: weaken a promote-gate threshold, run .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/violation_ratchet.py check --changed, expect the block, revert.
rows.falsifier: The ratchet passes a doctored gate weakening silently -> the non-weakening rule is not actually enforced and M7 must not ride on it.

rows.claim: An abliterated janitor rung is wired only if refusal removal survives quantization with no capability regression, tested by the card's own open question.
rows.quote: does refusal removal survive 4-bit quantization? That is exactly our probe to run.
rows.steal: Operator-gated sitting: abliterate gemma-2-2b-it via the local CLI path (never the hosted Space: telemetry default-on), convert -> Q4_K_M -> ollama, re-run the M2 battery; P3 steering-vector variant for the worker tier.
rows.falsifier: Refusals do not drop, or task success regresses, or probe20 drift pairs move -> no rung enters the scut tier; estate scope stays the operator's own local models only.

rows.claim: The distill/quantize cycle runs against the current frontier before Gemini 4 ships, while OpenAI's training pause holds the parity window open.
rows.quote: run the next distill/quantize cycle against the current frontier (Sonnet 5.5 / GPT-5.6-class) BEFORE Gemini 4 lands, while the parity window OpenAI's training pause opened is still open
rows.steal: One sitting: schedule the cycle and rerun the lane's Gemini 4 page-currency probe weekly into watch/inbox/48h_synth/m14_window_watch.md; dates decide the window's close.
rows.falsifier: Gemini 4 ships before the cycle runs -> the window closed and the row records the miss with dates on both sides.

rows.claim: Audit does not require a hyperscaler tenancy: the local box keeps prompt/retrieval/tool logs on disk with no outbound telemetry, made checkable.
rows.quote: Default-deny box: prompt/retrieval/tool log on disk, no outbound telemetry, so audit does not require a hyperscaler or Palantir tenancy.
rows.steal: One sitting: enumerate outbound endpoints in the mag/ tree into a default-deny attestation table at watch/inbox/48h_synth/m15_attestation.md, then watch one janitor cycle's outbound connections against the allowlist.
rows.falsifier: A janitor cycle emits any non-allowlisted outbound endpoint -> the default-deny claim is false and the endpoint becomes the backlog row.

rows.claim: The O(1)-per-token-memory janitor stays paper until a serving path exists; the check names the go/no-go.
rows.quote: RNN means O(1) per-token memory: long janitor sessions stop paying KV rent if the agent/coding claim survives re-ranking.
rows.steal: One sitting: search the Ollama library and the installed stack for anything loading RWKV-7 text, land the answer at watch/inbox/frontier_olm_20260928/sweep/_raw/rwkv7_serving_path.txt (card status: TO RUN).
rows.falsifier: No serving path found (expected) -> the probe's output is the go/no-go; a found path flips it to building the battery run on the estate's own instrument.

rows.quote: Following is sensing: their outputs bank as findings under the driving ladder, never as done. No interaction, no engagement from estate surfaces - read-only intelligence.
